q: Which of the following was not true about the effect of British rule in India ?
options: Tax free import of manufactured goods
Tax free import of Indian textile goods in U.K.
Development of jute industry by Britishers in India
Decline of cottage and small scale industries in India
key_text: Tax free import of Indian textile goods in U.K.
explanation: Indian textiles paid heavy duties in Britain while British goods came into India almost duty-free, so 'tax-free import of Indian textiles into the UK' is untrue.

notes.text: - **Charter Act of 1813** ended the Company's trade monopoly → **one-way free trade**: British goods entered India **duty-free / nominal duty**; Indian textiles paid **heavy duties in Britain** (already from the 1720 laws) – so "tax-free import of Indian textiles into the UK" is false.
